name: coder-gate-v1
description: MLLM Coder v1 (relay/runs/2026-09-14T16-14-10-757Z/deliverable.md). The governed unit is one diff against one pre-named file/hunk, not prose. The `propose` seat is external: THCMCP never writes code itself, it hands the change-request task file to an outside coding session and gets one fenced diff back (docs/coder-gate-diff-format.md). The `builder` seat is also external, held to the same session, and must return the proposal's diff verbatim as this chain's draft - there is no second, independent code-writing step; `builder` exists only because every chain needs one to reach a draft, not because a second author writes anything. `verify` (config.verify.enabled: true) wires the existing run_tests mechanism, but `verify.tools` ships empty here by design, not oversight: runVerification runs before any change-request/diff exists, and this repo has no `{{...}}` templating to inject a per-run target file/test command into a static chain config - a filled-in entry as specced would be inert. No test command runs automatically today (see test/coder-gate-verify.test.js's IN-3 fixture for how the mechanism works when a real, per-run `verify.tools` entry IS supplied downstream). No write-capable tool is used anywhere - applying the diff to a real working tree stays a human/external action. Built from existing stage types (proposal, critic, unanimous signoff); `debate: true` is set for forward compatibility but is currently unreachable - with one proposer and `proposals.parts: 1`, at most one proposal ever exists, and `runChain`'s debate stage only runs when `proposals.length > 1`, so v1 has no live debate today. No change to src/chain.js or src/tools.js.
